title: Update authenticated fragmented-DIO reassembly mock with Rule 255 provenance
description: python/tests/test_node.py::test_link_issues_authenticated_dio_from_verified_reassembly monkeypatches the SCHC reassembly manager to return (ReceiverResult, raw_ipv6), so LinkLayer assigns sentinel rule_id=-1 and the new authenticated-DIO Rule 255 provenance check rejects it. Update the mock to the current return contract including literal Rule 255 and retain an assertion that non-255 provenance is rejected.
